title: Communism in the Soviet Union
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:35Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point 'Stalin's Soviet Union' covers only Stalin's personal dictatorship, while the new point covers Lenin and Stalin together, one-party rule, state ownership of industry and farms, and terror, so it is narrower than the brief and would need new content rather than small changes.

draft.title: Communism in the Soviet Union
card: After the 1917 revolution, the Communist Party ruled alone under Lenin. Other parties were banned, and there were no free elections.
The state owned industry and, under Stalin, took over farms. Farmers were forced into collective farms, and the economy ran on state plans.
The secret police, labour camps and show trials were used against opponents. Under Stalin, the Great Terror of the late 1930s killed or jailed millions.
After Lenin died in 1924, Stalin won the power struggle and became the leader with the most power.
draft.remember: Soviet communism meant one party, state ownership and terror against opponents.

a.q: What did Stalin's collectivisation do to Soviet farming?
opts: Farms were taken from private owners and run collectively
Farmers were given larger plots to run for profit
Farms were handed to local elected councils
Farm owners were paid to sell land to the state
a.why: Collectivisation moved farmland out of private hands into collective farms under state control. Private profit and elected control did not fit one-party state ownership, which is why those options are wrong.

b.q: In 1937 a Soviet official is arrested after a short show trial and sent to a labour camp. What does this show about Stalin's rule?
opts: Courts could rule against the government
Opposition parties were allowed to compete
Officials were chosen by free elections
b.why: Show trials and labour camps were tools of terror used to remove opponents. A trial staged to reach a set result is not independent, so it does not show courts that could rule against the government.
b.clue: Was the trial a real test of guilt?

a.best: Farms were taken from private owners and run collectively

check.summary: No problems found. The point covers state terror and mass deaths under Stalin, so it is marked sensitive for review.
